row.title: Oversized PRs hide scratch; refuse them
row.body: ops PR 45 changed 3,194 files, 3,158 of them session scratch copies. SMALL-CHANGE-1 (seed/scripts/prsize.py, in checks) fails a PR over 60 files or 3,000 lines or carrying wip/ paths. The work was salvaged into ops #46 and kept on archive/pr45-spec-held-work.

title: Oversized PRs hide scratch; refuse them
